fields.acceptance: A test of daemon.Resumable (internal/daemon/pick.go) and a daemon poll testscript resume an interrupted plan run on a landed record once and journal the resume, and resume neither a plan run on a withdrawn change set nor a build run on a landed one; the existing daemon-resumes-accepted-only and daemon-resume-once tests keep passing
fields.statement: The daemon resumes an interrupted plan-workflow run whose change set has landed once, as it does a run on an accepted change set, while it still leaves alone a plan run whose change set is rejected, withdrawn or superseded and every other workflow's run on a change set that is not accepted

ops.note: Same exemption as rhiza run resume: plan workflow, landed state only

fields.acceptance: A testscript with plan runs on a landed record shows no skipped item for an interrupted one, a gave-up item naming rhiza run resume for one interrupted after a daemon resume, and a failed item naming rhiza run resume --retry for a failed one; in the same suite a build run interrupted on a landed change set is still skipped with rhiza run abandon and a plan run on a withdrawn change set is still skipped, and the unaccepted-run-in-inbox tests keep passing
fields.statement: rhiza inbox counts a plan-workflow run whose change set has landed as in flight: it never lists it as skipped with rhiza run abandon, lists it as gave-up with rhiza run resume <run> when interrupted again after the daemon's one resume, and as failed with rhiza run resume --retry <run> when it failed, while plan runs on rejected, withdrawn or superseded change sets and other workflows' runs on terminal change sets stay skipped or hidden as before

ops.note: Exempts a plan run on a landed record from this skipped item
